name: architectural_loop
description: Orchestrates a multi-phase architectural workflow: generates HLD, decomposes into stages, and iteratively implements each stage via sub-tasks.

args.content:
# Stage Tracker for ContractGenie

- [ ] Stage 0: Infrastructure & API Specs (Tests: DB Connectivity)
- [ ] Stage 1: User Service (Tests: JWT Auth)
- [ ] Stage 2: PDF Service (Tests: PDF Generation)
- [ ] Stage 3: Contract Service (Tests: Orchestration & Email)
- [ ] Stage 4: Frontend & Nginx (Tests: E2E Flow)

args.title: Stage 0: Infrastructure & API Specs
args.description: Initialize Docker Compose with PostgreSQL/Nginx and create api-spec.json as defined in the blueprint. Verify with Stage 0 test cases.

args.title: Stage 1: User Service
args.description: Implement User Service in backend/user-service with JWT auth as defined in the blueprint. Verify with Stage 1 test cases.

args.title: Stage 2: PDF Service
args.description: Implement PDF Service in backend/pdf-service for document generation as defined in the blueprint. Verify with Stage 2 test cases.

args.title: Stage 3: Contract Service
args.description: Implement Contract Service in backend/contract-service with SendGrid as defined in the blueprint. Verify with Stage 3 test cases.

args.title: Stage 4: Frontend & Nginx
args.description: Implement React frontend and Nginx routing as defined in the blueprint. Verify with Stage 4 test cases.
